description: This file defines a React component named 'ComponentLibrary' that provides a UI for selecting and previewing different components, themes, and backgrounds within a component library for Mattermost. It manages state for selected component, theme, and background, and applies themes dynamically.

methods.name: ComponentLibrary
methods.description: React functional component that renders a UI for selecting components, themes, and backgrounds, and displays the selected component with applied theme and background.
